title: Consciousness is rooted in brainstem interoception

statements.text: Consciousness is part of a neurobiological process for homeostatic regulation, rooted in interoception and in lower-order brainstem structures, rather than in the activity of higher cortical regions or the complexity of cortical interactions.

sources.locator: 4(b) the unique features of the vagus nerve system
sources.quote: the brainstem-centred perspective we favour posits consciousness as part of a neurobiological process dedicated to homoeostatic regulation, rooted in interoception and in lower-order brainstem structures
